note: Subscriber submodule of entity_share_websub; the only configurable one. Real config object entity_share_websub_subscriber.settings with keys hide_default_button, break_subscription_on_edit, import_config, subscribe_hub_url (default /subscribe), cancel_title/description/text/confirm_text. Settings form at /admin/config/entity-share-websub-subscriber (permission 'administer entity share websub subscriber settings'). Callback routes /subscription/{subscription_key} are _access TRUE, authenticated via X-Hub-Signature. Medium introspection reads back a known config value; hard execution writes config keys, verified against live config. Easy cases cover config route/keys, callback auth, and the pull-form buttons.

evals.prompt: On a site with entity_share_websub_subscriber, where is its settings form, and which single setting must you choose for the automated background sync to work?
evals.expected_output: The form is at /admin/config/entity-share-websub-subscriber (route entity_share_websub_subscriber.settings, config object entity_share_websub_subscriber.settings). You must select an 'Import config' (import_config) — the Entity Share import configuration the automated sync uses.

evals.prompt: The entity_share_websub_subscriber module exposes /subscription/{subscription_key} callback routes with no permission requirement (_access TRUE). How are incoming hub requests to these routes actually authenticated?
evals.expected_output: They are authenticated by recomputing the X-Hub-Signature (HMAC sha256 over the request data with the per-subscription secret, via the base module's SignatureTrait) and comparing it to the incoming header. There is no Drupal permission; a mismatch is rejected (update/delete still return 202 to prevent brute-forcing).

evals.prompt: How does a content editor actually subscribe to remote content with entity_share_websub_subscriber, and what setting hides Entity Share's default manual sync button?
evals.expected_output: The module adds Subscribe/Unsubscribe buttons (and a status column) to the Entity Share client pull form; the editor selects entities and clicks Subscribe. Setting hide_default_button = true removes Entity Share's built-in 'Synchronize' button from that form.

evals.prompt: This site's entity_share_websub_subscriber has been configured with a custom hub subscribe endpoint path. Inspect the live configuration and report the value of the subscribe hub URL setting.
evals.expected_output: config entity_share_websub_subscriber.settings has subscribe_hub_url = /eswsub-known-hub (drush cget entity_share_websub_subscriber.settings subscribe_hub_url).

evals.prompt: Configure entity_share_websub_subscriber on this site so that Entity Share's default Synchronize button is hidden and the hub subscribe endpoint path is set to /eswsub-target. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In config entity_share_websub_subscriber.settings, hide_default_button === true and subscribe_hub_url === '/eswsub-target' (e.g. via drush cset or the settings form at /admin/config/entity-share-websub-subscriber).

evals.prompt: This site's entity_share_websub_subscriber has a customized title for the cancel-subscription confirmation form. Inspect the live configuration and report that cancel form title.
evals.expected_output: config entity_share_websub_subscriber.settings has cancel_title = 'ESW Cancel Now?' (drush cget entity_share_websub_subscriber.settings cancel_title).

evals.prompt: Configure entity_share_websub_subscriber so that editors are asked to cancel the subscription before they edit imported content (the 'break subscription on edit' behavior). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In config entity_share_websub_subscriber.settings, break_subscription_on_edit === true (drush cset entity_share_websub_subscriber.settings break_subscription_on_edit true, or tick 'Ask to cancel subscription' on the settings form).
